name: Guanfacine
summary: Guanfacine, sold under the brand name Tenex (immediate-release) and Intuniv (extended-release) among others, is an oral alpha-2a agonist medication used to treat attention deficit hyperactivity disorder (ADHD) and high blood pressure.

pharmacology.text: Guanfacine is a highly selective agonist of the α2A-adrenergic receptor, with low affinity for other receptors. It is also a serotonin 5-HT2B receptor agonist. Guanfacine works by activating α2A-adrenoceptors within the central nervous system. This leads to reduced peripheral sympathetic outflow and thus a reduction in peripheral sympathetic tone, which lowers both systolic and diastolic blood pressure.

body.says: IR: 10–17 hours; XR: 17 hours (10–30) in adults & adolescents and 14 hours in children

uses.text: Guanfacine IR (as the brand name Tenex) is FDA-approved for the management of hypertension. Guanfacine XR (as brand name Intuniv) is indicated for the treatment of attention deficit hyperactivity disorder (ADHD), primarily for hyperactive symptoms. It is used both as monotherapy and as adjunctive therapy to stimulant medications. In some cases, it can also help control the side effect profile of stimulant medications.

sideEffects.text: Common side effects include sleepiness, constipation, and dry mouth.

summaryZh: 胍法辛（英語：Guanfacine）以Tenex（速釋劑型和Intuniv、樂兒靜（緩釋劑型）等品牌銷售，是一種口服α-2A腎上腺素受體激動劑，用於治療注意力不足過動症 和高血壓。胍法辛經美國食品藥物管理局批准用於ADHD的單一療法，也可用於增強其他藥品（例如興奮劑）的輔助之用。

fact.en: Guanfacine was first sold in the 1980s as a blood pressure pill. Decades later, a slow-release form was approved for ADHD, because it strengthens signalling in the prefrontal cortex, the brain area behind attention and planning.
fact.zh: 胍法辛在 1980 年代最初作為降血壓藥上市。數十年後，它的緩釋劑型獲准用於注意力不足過動症，因為它能強化前額葉皮質的訊號，而這個腦區負責專注和規劃。
fact.zhHans: 胍法辛在 1980 年代最初作为降血压药上市。数十年后，它的缓释剂型获准用于注意力不足过动症，因为它能强化前额叶皮质的信号，而这个脑区负责专注和规划。
